8051832520751.title: Elixir
8051832520751.description:
A fragrance of sophistication and allure, Elixir is crafted for those who appreciate depth, complexity, and elegance in every detail. It opens with a vibrant burst of spice and citrus, unfolds into a rich aromatic heart, and settles into a warm, indulgent base that lingers with timeless refinement.

Key Highlights

  • Eau de Parfum concentration for long-lasting wear
  • A perfect balance of freshness, spice, and warmth
  • Suited for evening wear, formal occasions, and signature style
  • Crafted for the discerning individual who values refinement and presence

Fragrance Story

Elixir embodies the art of transformation — the spark of energy, the depth of character, and the warmth of legacy. Each note is meticulously composed to create a scent that is both modern and timeless, making it the perfect expression of elegance and strength.

How to Apply

Spray onto pulse points — wrists, neck, and behind the ears — for a long-lasting and elegant scent trail.

8051832487983.title: Explorer
8051832487983.description:
Collapsible Sections — Reference Style
Description

Designed for the modern adventurer, Explorer is a refined fragrance that balances freshness, warmth, and earthy sophistication. It opens with bright citrus and crisp fruit, moves into a delicate floral heart, and settles into a rich, long-lasting base. A scent crafted for those who seek new horizons with confidence and style.

Key Highlights
  • Long-lasting Eau de Parfum concentration
  • Perfect for daytime wear, travel, and exploration
  • A dynamic balance of fresh, floral, and woody-earthy accords
  • Crafted for men who embody curiosity, refinement, and adventure
Fragrance Story

Every journey begins with a spark. Explorer captures that moment — the freshness of new beginnings, the calm balance of nature, and the grounding strength of experience. It is more than a scent; it is an expression of wanderlust, sophistication, and resilience.

How to Apply

Spray lightly on pulse points — wrists, neck, and behind the ears — for a long-lasting scent trail.
